lines: If you're a licensed agent, the Insurance side is a powerful second income. Let's cover it.
On this side, you sell life insurance and earn a commission on every policy you write.
Your commission is a share of the first-year premium — and that share grows as you rank up.
You're contracted directly with top carriers, so your commissions are paid straight to you.
And the business you write is yours. You own your book — it stays with you as you grow.
Build a team of agents, and you earn override income on their production too.
You climb by writing consistent, quality business — production and persistency.
It pairs perfectly with the tech side: same team, two income streams.
If you're licensed, this is where a great month becomes a great year.
That's the Insurance side. Next, a quick tour of how you actually get paid. Let's go.
